### Zone 1 — Adjudicated. ⛔ Not re-litigable, quoted rather than paraphrased.

Director seat, **decision batch #119 item 1**, 2026-09-12T04:15Z; maintainer's own word to the batch presented as `1A·2A·3A·4D·5A`: 「同意」. Implemented by `ef47459474` (#17896, `Fixes #17026`) — the precedent this card copies:

>

>

And the boundary that makes it legitimate, also verbatim:

> Immutability belongs to the **shipped npm tarball**, which this ruling does not and cannot touch; it does not belong to the repository's markdown.

⛔ Two standing prohibitions this card sits next to: a code PR never edits `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` (which is exactly why this is its own PR and was kept out of #17635), and a PM or dev **never** runs a release or merges the Version Packages PR.

---

### Zone 2 — PM mechanism assumptions. Every line is a **premise to falsify first**.

Readings taken by this seat from `origin/main` @ `484484041a`, 2026-09-13T19:00Z.

**②‑1 · The text.** `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:2865-2869`, inside the already-released `## 17.4.0` section, under *"Keys deliberately left alone"*:

> `ServiceLevelObjective.errorBudget`'s burn-rate `window` and the OpenTelemetry exporter `timeout` name no unit anywhere in their prose, so both are outside the gate's population entirely. Pin tests assert each of these, so a later sweep cannot read this card as "every duration-shaped number on these files".

Re-locate it **by content, not by line number** — #17076 or any other merge can move it.

**②‑2 · Half 1 is falsified by #17783.** `packages/spec/src/system/metrics.zod.ts:368-375` carries the retirement string stating the burn-rate `window` *"was renamed to `durationSeconds` in @objectstack/spec 17"*, and explaining why not `windowSeconds`. The pin that held the bare spelling is now `it('REFUSES the burn-rate \`window\` with a rename naming \`durationSeconds\`', …)`.

**②‑3 · Half 2 is falsified by #17785.** `packages/spec/src/system/tracing.zod.ts:546` is `timeoutMs: z.number().int().positive().optional().default(10000)` with `timeout: retiredKey(` at `:550`; the sibling went the same way (`exportTimeoutMs` `:586`, `exportTimeout: retiredKey(` `:601`).

⇒ All three of the sentence's claims are false: *"name no unit anywhere in their prose"*, *"outside the gate's population entirely"*, and the pin-test assertion. ⚠️ Verify each yourself — a correction built on my reading rather than yours is how a second erratum gets written later.

**②‑4 · ⚠️ The survival gate is MANDATORY and ⛔ must NOT be inherited.** The precedent PR measured that a manual edit inside an already-compiled section survives `changeset version` (marker present before and after, pushed down but intact, with a lit control proving the tool really rewrote the files). **Re-run it here** on a scratch branch off the same base, with your own marker and your own lit control, then discard the branch. **If the edit does not survive: stop and report.** ⛔ Do not proceed on #17896's result — that is exactly the "relayed rather than measured" failure this epic has already paid for once.

**②‑5 · One open PR collides, and it is the release PR.** **#17076** (`chore: version packages`) rewrites **78** CHANGELOG files including this one — measured, with that 78 as the lit control for the single hit and a fabricated package path reading 0. No other open PR touches this file. ⛔ Do not touch, merge, rebase or work around #17076. If it merges first, your branch conflicts on this file and the resolution is to re-locate the sentence by content in the new layout and re-apply — ⛔ never to accept either side wholesale.

**②‑6 · `skip-changeset`.** No package publishes anything from this change. Follow the precedent; if the changeset gate disagrees on this diff, report what it said rather than adding a changeset to quiet it.

---

### Zone 3 — Suggested route. ⛔ Not adjudicated; measurement beats it.

1. Worktree `objectstack-issue-18076`, branch `claude/issue-18076-changelog-duration-keys-erratum` off `484484041a`.
2. **Survival gate first (②‑4), before any edit.** Record the readings.
3. Correct the sentence to the post-#17783 / post-#17785 truth, and append **one erratum line naming this PR and the correction date**, matching `ef47459474`'s shape. Keep the surrounding paragraph's other claims (`FailoverConfig.dns.ttl`, `CacheAvalanchePrevention.lockout.lockTimeoutMs`, `MetricExportConfig.batch.size`, `QueueConfig.rateLimit.max`) — ⚠️ but **check each one is still true** while you are in there, and report any that is not rather than silently correcting beyond scope.
4. Derive and run the gate family (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`), reconcile with `--ran`. Exit 3 is `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` — ⛔ neither pass nor finding.
5. Push, open a **draft** PR, report. ⛔ Do not turn it ready, ⛔ do not enqueue, ⛔ do not touch labels.

⚠️ **The one stop-and-report that matters:** if correcting the text would change what the released 17.4.0 is described as having *done*, rather than correcting a claim about what is *true now*, that is outside batch #119's shape — **stop and report**, and it goes to the decision box instead.
